---
title: "CNV Genomic Profile — Rolling Average by Chromosome"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    code-fold: true
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggh4x)
library(zoo)

CNV_FILE <- "/projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/data_handoff/CNV_slim.txt"
DEMO_FILE <- "/projects/regulated/cdni-nih-bdc/shared/data/HBCD/HBCD_prerelease_tabulated_data/phenotype/sed_basic_demographics.tsv"
fam <- read_tsv("/projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/data/HBCD.fam", col_names = F)

race_names <- c("0" = "WHT", "1" = "BLK", "2" = "AIAN",
                "3" = "ASN", "4" = "HPI", "5" = "2PLUS",
                "6" = "OTH", "7" = "UNK")
race_colors <- c("WHT" = "#1f78b4", "BLK" = "#e31a1c", "AIAN" = "#33a02c",
                 "ASN" = "#ff7f00", "HPI" = "#6a3d9a", "2PLUS" = "#b15928",
                 "OTH" = "#cab2d6", "UNK" = "#999999")


dm <- read_tsv(DEMO_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(participant_id = str_remove(participant_id, "^sub-"))

IDENTIFIERS_FILE <- "/projects/standard/basu_hbcd/shared/data/release_identifiers_20260628.csv"
ids <- read_csv(IDENTIFIERS_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(release_candid != "release_candid") %>%
  distinct(pscid, release_candid)

child_lookup <- dm %>%
  filter(session_id == "ses-V02") %>%
  reframe(.by = participant_id,
    race = {
      r <- na.omit(sed_basic_demographics_child_race)
      if (length(r) == 0) "UNK" else race_names[as.character(names(sort(table(r), decreasing = TRUE))[1])]
    },
  ) %>%
  transmute(release_candid = participant_id, type = "C")

mother_lookup <- dm %>%
  filter(session_id == "ses-V01") %>%
  reframe(.by = participant_id,
    race = {
      r <- na.omit(sed_basic_demographics_screen_mother_race)
      if (length(r) == 0) "UNK" else race_names[as.character(names(sort(table(r), decreasing = TRUE))[1])]
    },
  ) %>%
  transmute(release_candid = participant_id, type = "M")

demos <- bind_rows(child_lookup, mother_lookup)

remove <- read_csv("../data/Remove.txt", col_names = F)
# GRCh38 chromosome lengths
chrlens <- c(248956422, 242193529, 198295559, 190214555, 181538259,
             170805979, 159345973, 145138636, 138394717, 133797422,
             135086622, 133275309, 114364328, 107043718, 101991189,
             90338345, 83257441, 80373285, 58617616, 64444167,
             46709983, 50818468, 156040895, 57227415)
names(chrlens) <- as.character(c(1:22, "X", "Y"))
chr_offset <- setNames(c(0, cumsum(head(chrlens, -1))), names(chrlens))
df <- read_tsv(CNV_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    type = str_extract(sample_id, "[CM]$"),
    pscid = str_remove(str_split_i(sample_id, "_", 3), "[CM]$")
  )
df |>
  filter(!sample_id %in% remove$X1) |>
  filter(sample_id %in% fam$X1) |>
  left_join(ids, by = "pscid") %>%
  left_join(demos, by = c("release_candid", "type")) |>
  mutate(
    b_allele_freq = as.numeric(b_allele_freq),
    chr_num = case_when(
      chromosome == "X" ~ 23L,
      chromosome == "Y" ~ 24L,
      TRUE ~ as.integer(chromosome)
    ),
    pos_cum = position + chr_offset[as.character(chr_num)],
  )

cat("Rows:", scales::comma(nrow(df)), "\n")
cat("Samples:", scales::comma(n_distinct(df$sample_id)), "\n")
cat("Chromosomes:", n_distinct(df$chromosome), "\n")
```

# Genomic Profile

Rolling median (k = 51 SNPs) of each CNV metric across each chromosome, computed per race × type group. Chromosome facets use independent scales via `ggh4x::facet_wrap2`. Colored by reported race, linetype distinguishes child (C) and mother (M).

```{r}
#| label: roll
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

df_roll <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(type), !is.na(race), !is.na(chr_num)) %>%
  group_by(chr_num, race, type) %>%
  arrange(pos_cum) %>%
  mutate(
    roll_lrr = rollmedian(log_r_ratio, k = 51, fill = NA),
    roll_baf = rollmedian(b_allele_freq, k = 51, fill = NA),
    roll_cnv = rollmedian(cnv_value, k = 51, fill = NA)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Rolling avg computed — rows:", scales::comma(nrow(df_roll)), "\n")
```

## Log R Ratio

```{r}
#| label: roll-lrr
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 12
df_roll %>%
  filter(!is.na(roll_lrr)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(position / 1e6, roll_lrr, color = race, linetype = type)) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE, linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap2(~chr_num, scales = "free", axes = "all") +
  scale_color_manual(values = race_colors) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = "Log R Ratio (rolling median, k=51)",
       color = "Race", linetype = "Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 8))
```

## B Allele Frequency

```{r}
#| label: roll-baf
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 12
df_roll %>%
  filter(!is.na(roll_baf)) %>%

  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE, linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap2(~chr_num, scales = "free", axes = "all") +
  scale_color_manual(values = race_colors) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = "BAF (rolling median, k=51)",
       color = "Race", linetype = "Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 8))
```

## CNV Value

```{r}
#| label: roll-cnv
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 12
df_roll %>%
  filter(!is.na(roll_cnv)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(position / 1e6, roll_cnv, color = race, linetype = type)) +
  geom_line(na.rm = TRUE, linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap2(~chr_num, scales = "free", axes = "all") +
  scale_color_manual(values = race_colors) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = "CNV value (rolling median, k=51)",
       color = "Race", linetype = "Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 8))
```
